testScenario: Lab 3 - Scenario 5: Scheduling API Failure and Incident Recovery
description: Simulates hospital scheduling API server failing (HTTP 503 Service Unavailable). Zeebe REST connector triggers incident in Operate. Operator diagnoses downtime, remedies endpoint, and retries incident to successful appointment confirmation.

operateIncidentInspection.errorMessage: REST Connector returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable: Mock scheduling subsystem is temporarily offline

incidentResolution.correctiveAction: Toggle simulateApiFailure=false in payload or restore mock scheduling controller.
incidentResolution.retryAction: Trigger Retry Incident in Camunda 8 Operate.
incidentResolution.expectedPostRecoveryState: Available slot retrieved (SLOT-ORTHO-1145), token proceeds to Activity_ConfirmBooking and finishes successfully.
